ideas.pitch: A localized AML risk detection and graph intelligence platform tailored for regional credit unions and banks in South Carolina.
ideas.title: PalmettoGrid AML Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of Bito which won 1st place at DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon by combining graph intelligence with explainable risk scoring.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform assessing agricultural land compliance and crop health for the South Carolina Department of Agriculture.
ideas.title: PalmettoAgri Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mimics GeoNex-ATLAS which secured runner-up at Xcelerate Hackathon by applying satellite monitoring to solve regional industrial or land compliance problems.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous AI agent marketplace with secure stablecoin escrow payments designed for local vendor hiring and tourism services in Charleston and Columbia.
ideas.title: Carolina Coast Event Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates Dispatch which won 1st place at the Synthesis Hackathon by implementing an autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and advising platform combining RAG and personalized AI agents specifically tailored for South Carolina university course catalogs.
ideas.title: Palmetto Campus AI Support Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors greennovation-ai-platform which won 1st place at GreenNovation Hackathon using LangGraph, RAG, and personalized multi-agent student support workflows.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on local South Carolina grocery store inventory and dietary needs.
ideas.title: Palmetto Palate AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant which won first prize at Hour Hackathon by building a practical, localized health and nutrition recommendation assistant.
